nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Alcohol-Free Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe the toner as balancing, non-greasy and non-drying, useful as a winter moisture boost or as an all-year step, though one very oily acne-prone reviewer was initially wary of the milky texture before finding it absorbed well.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry or winter-dry skin, consistently report the toner does not strip, tighten, or dry out their face, and several call it their best toner for dryness, though one dry-skin reviewer says it did not work and left her skin dry and red.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances their skin without making it oily and helps even out texture and tone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, eczema or reactive skin, most often report the toner as calming, non-irritating and fragrance-light with no stinging, though a minority describe breakouts, eczema flare-ups or burning on first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin describe it as gentle yet effective alongside anti-aging steps like vitamin C serum, with one long-time user reporting reduced fine lines.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing average or normal skin report fewer breakouts and smoother, brighter-looking skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using this toner as part of an anti-aging routine report smoother texture and, in one case, diminished fine lines; comments on aging are otherwise limited and mostly positive.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry or winter-dry skin, report the toner is hydrating and non-stripping, with several saying they could skip moisturizer; one reviewer nonetheless reports it left her skin dry and red.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea generally report the toner calms and soothes their skin without stinging, though one reviewer reports irritation and a burning sensation.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or eczema-prone skin mostly report no irritation and improved comfort, but a couple describe eczema flare-ups or burning that led them to stop using it.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fewer, smaller, or faster-clearing pimples and improved texture over weeks; a few others report new breakouts or cystic acne appearing after starting use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers dealing with active blemishes and post-acne marks report reduced breakouts and improved hyperpigmentation/scarring over time, though one reviewer says her acne had not cleared after four days and another reports no real improvement.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently describe the toner as balancing sebum without adding oiliness or leaving a greasy residue.

aspects.libelle: Soft, refreshed skin feel after use
Slow to absorb into cotton pad
Fragrance or smell bothers some users

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this. I wanted to love this so much that I went and purchased the full size of it when the travel size was already burning my skin to the ground. I didn't even get to use this toner for two weeks. After the first week of consistent use, my face began to break out into pimples along my chin & cheeks and my eczema flared up terribly. I do not have acne prone skin. At all. My face is dry & eczema prone. I stopped using this toner. It hasn't even been a full week and my skin is almost back to normal. The only thing I did was stop using this toner. This is disappointing because everything else from this line is amazing.

I'm 42 with combo/dry thats also a bit sensitive skin. I've used every toner from the drug store to department store for decades and they all ended up too either too harsh, overly drying, or did nothing at all. iv used the ordinary 7% glycolic acid and when my skin needs some good intensive exfoliating ( which is a great, inexpensive product) but that's once maybe twice a month and at night only! the rest of the year I use this toner! its reduced my redness significantly imo ! doesn't burn / sting or leave me feeling stripped! P's. a little goes along way and be careful when applying to cotton pad it can come out fast causing wasted products !

I have extemely oily skin. Even so, during the winter, I need an extra boost of hydration. This toner is perfect. It reminds me of a very thin milk. The liquid is not thick at all, and I just pat it on my face to help push it in my pores. I use 2-3 different toners on my face each time, and the products vary depending on the season. I use this during the fall and winter months. I highly recommend this if you want a little boost of moisture. Did not break me out and went beautifully with my other skincare products and under my make-up.

extraits.titre: Good for sensitive skin, hydrating af
extraits.texte: I LOVE this toner. I've been using it since 2016 and nothing compares. I have acne prone, eczema prone, sensitive skin. This really sinks into my skin. I notice a difference in my skin when I run out. Kiehl's please release a travel size

I was at first scared about this toner since it does have a milky consistency and I have very oily acne-prone skin. However, this sinks right into the skin and doesn't leave a residue and gives the right amount of hydration with only using a small amount of it. My skin looks so GOOD after just using it a couple of times! I rarely have breakouts now and my skin texture has definitely improved thanks to this toner. It's definitely worth the money.

I have super dry skin and most toners tend to immediately dry it out and make it feel tight. After a lot of research I bought the Kiehl's toner and I am never going back! First off, you only need about three drops of it to cover your entire face - and then maybe another one to cover your neck. A little definitely goes a long way, making it well worth the price. Secondly, my skin feels brighter and has been breakout free since I started using it. I love the little bit of moisture it adds to my skincare routine. I would recommend you pair this with another moisturizer/sunscreen as well, if you have dry skin like me.

I thought that I was doomed to have a pimple or two every month until menopause. It didn't bother me too much, but it was annoying. I got a sample of this toner and suddenly I went 8 weeks without a zit. I get pimples much less frequently now, they are smaller, and they only last 2-3 days (compared with 1-2+ weeks before). I will say, it does dry out my cheeks a little bit, but I don't get acne there anyway so I just skip that part of my face.
